description: This file is a test script for Git, written in shell script language. It sets up a repository, manipulates refs with odd or long names, and checks Git's behavior with those refs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and commands to run.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets a prerequisite for the test scenario.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
